basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Manchester Global Futures Scholarship
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Manchester (Oxford Road Campus, Manchester)
degree_levels: Master of Science (MSc / MA / MEng / LLM)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Postgraduate taught master's programmes across all Manchester faculties: Computer Science, Engineering, Biotechnology, Data Science, Economics, and Alliance Manchester Business School.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 120 competitive Global Futures Scholarships awarded across South Asia and international regions
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Dedicated South Asia quota; typically 10 to 18 Pakistani postgraduate students receive awards annually

nationality_requirements: Domiciled international fee-paying applicants from Pakistan and South Asia
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction under University of Manchester admissions policies.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16-year BS / BSc / BE) from an HEC-recognized university with high academic standing (minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 or 78%+ equivalent to UK First Class / High 2:1 Honours).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.70 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Must hold an offer (conditional or unconditional) to study an eligible full-time master's course at Manchester starting in September 2027.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate year graduating prior to August 2027.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Relevant internships, community leadership, open source projects, or professional practice provide rich material for scholarship essays.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 to 7.0 depending on program (no band below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT minimum 90 to 100. MOI certificates are not accepted.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Merit-based competition assessing academic excellence, leadership potential, and commitment to contributing to UN Sustainable Development Goals.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with another full UK government scholarship (e.g. Chevening or Commonwealth).

tuition_fee.details: Full International Tuition Fees Waived up to GBP 28,000 (covers 100% of most master's programmes; remaining tuition covered via departmental bursary).

admission_application_fee.details: Online application fee of GBP 60 for Alliance Manchester Business School programmes (free for science and engineering faculties).

accommodation.details: Subsidized University of Manchester student halls of residence across Fallowfield and City campuses.

monthly_stipend.details: GBP 1,250 / month living stipend (~PKR 465,000 / month) provided through combined faculty bursaries and university maintenance allowances.

airfare.details: International airfare between Pakistan and Manchester is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: UK Student Visa fee (~GBP 490) and Immigration Health Surcharge (~GBP 776/year) covered by candidate.
visa_fee.amount: UK Visa & IHS fees borne by candidate

health_insurance.details: Full access to the UK National Health Service (NHS) throughout the master's degree programme.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized student dining across Manchester Students' Union and campus cafeterias.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital access to University of Manchester Main Library and John Rylands Research Institute.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Master thesis laboratory facilities, engineering high-performance compute clusters, and digital innovation spaces.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized Manchester Stagecoach student bus transit passes.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (University of Manchester, Manchester, UK).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World top 35 university (QS World University Rankings 2025); Russell Group member; world leader in sustainable development.
available_majors: MSc in Advanced Computer Science (AI, Data, Systems)
MSc in Communications and Signal Processing
MSc in Renewable Energy & Clean Technology
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 1 year (12 months full-time taught master's degree)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree with CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00, IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+, Manchester admission offer letter, and completed Global Futures Scholarship webform.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must hold an offer of admission for an eligible master's course before submitting the scholarship webform by April 10.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Align scholarship essay responses with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and demonstrate how Manchester studies will create positive social or technological impact.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Manchester Postgraduate Application Portal & Scholarship Webform
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for an eligible master's course at Manchester and receive your 7-digit student ID. Step 2: Once an offer is issued, receive an invitation link to the Global Futures Scholarship online application form. Step 3: Complete the scholarship essays and submit before April 10.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Apply for an eligible full-time postgraduate taught master's degree at Manchester via the online application system.
Step 2: Receive an offer of admission (conditional or unconditional) and your University of Manchester student ID number.
Step 3: Access the Global Futures Scholarship online application form using your student ID.
Step 4: Answer the required scholarship essay prompts detailing academic achievements, leadership, and SDG contributions.
Step 5: Submit the scholarship application before April 10, 23:59 UK time.
Step 6: Faculty and International Office selection panels review and score submissions.
Step 7: Successful recipients notified by late May.
Step 8: Accept the scholarship within the specified deadline and initiate UK Student Visa application.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first hold an admission offer, then complete the dedicated Global Futures Scholarship webform.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted as part of the initial course application via referee upload link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Specific essay prompts detailing: (1) Academic achievements and leadership capabilities, (2) Motivation for studying at Manchester, (3) How chosen programme helps address UN Sustainable Development Goals in home country.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated within the course personal statement.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard professional CV detailing qualifications, work experience, coding toolsets, and extracurriculars.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interview; decisions are based exclusively on academic profile and the quality of the scholarship essay responses.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 90+.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: GBP 0 for Science/Engineering; GBP 60 for Business School courses
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation for all official records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via University of Manchester Global Futures portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in relevant discipline (minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00).
Complete transcripts of undergraduate records showing all course marks and grades.
Proof of conditional or unconditional admission offer containing Manchester student ID.
Completed answers to the scholarship essay prompts detailing achievements, leadership, and SDG impact.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Craft compelling answers aligned with Manchester's social responsibility vision.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Professional CV detailing academic qualifications, technical projects, and extracurriculars.
Recommendation letters from university professors submitted with course application.
Official IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 90) test certificate.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Scholarship webform closes April 10, 23:59 UK time; applicants must hold a programme offer before applying.

selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 15% (Leadership track record and community initiative demonstrated in essays)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Technical capability, project background, and practical achievements)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 20% (Quality, articulation, and vision demonstrated in the scholarship application responses)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: University of Manchester International Scholarships Committee and Faculty Representatives.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Scoring rubric assessing intellectual merit, future ambition, and capacity to act as a global ambassador.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 5,000 international applicants across all regions
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100 to 120 competitive awards across postgraduate programmes
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3% to 5% among applicants holding strong GPAs and compelling essays
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates across STEM, engineering, and data science with solid academic records and dedicated social or community involvement.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, LUMS, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Malaysia, Kenya, Indonesia, Ghana, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official University of Manchester portal https://www.manchester.ac.uk/.
Never pay any fee to agents claiming to secure Manchester scholarships.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for Manchester postgraduate courses is free (except Business School GBP 60); scholarship application is 100% free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Manchester explicitly states that scholarship essays must be the applicant's own work; agency-written generic essays are penalized.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Application fee: GBP 0 (or GBP 60 for AMBS).
Flight from Pakistan to Manchester: ~PKR 150,000 to 220,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can apply for the scholarship without a course offer. Reality: You must hold an active course offer to submit the scholarship application form.
Myth: Living in Manchester is as expensive as London. Reality: Manchester has a significantly lower cost of living than London while offering world-class student life.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sources claim late scholarship applications are considered; Manchester strictly closes the portal at 23:59 UK time on April 10.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance throughout the master's programme.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time study attendance; scholars must agree to participate in international student promotional activities and ambassador events.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Term-by-term academic progress monitoring by the faculty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted up to 20 hours per week during term time under UK Student Visa rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Act as an International Student Ambassador during the year of study.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of award if student withdraws from programme or engages in disciplinary breach.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Subject change allowed only within eligible Manchester postgraduate taught programmes with faculty approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the 1-year duration of the postgraduate taught master's programme.
